Also each case independent; cases up to4 total sum128. Let's benchmark C++ PLAN via main with synthetic JSON or direct plan. DP dominates R64. Two R64 likely ~? Let's run time. cd /workspace && python3 -B - <<'PY' > /tmp/worst.plan
import random
random.seed(1)
# Two versions R=64, many bursts, cache 12
lines=['PLAN 1', '12 2 17 0 1 2 2 256']
versions=[]
for v in range(2):
    starts=[0]
    for i in range(1,64):
        # mix of small local offsets and large spread
        starts.append(starts[-1]+random.randint(1, 1<<80))
    hops=[None if random.random()<.1 else random.randint(0,2147483647) for _ in range(64)]
    versions.append((starts,hops))
    lines.append('64')
    lines += [f'{s:032x} {-1 if h is None else h}' for s,h in zip(starts,hops)]
for b in range(256):
    v=b%2; rep=random.randint(1,1000000); A=32
    addrs=[]
    starts,hops=versions[v]
    for _ in range(A):
        r=random.randrange(64); end=starts[r+1] if r+1<64 else starts[r]+1
        # choose run start (avoid narrow random)
        addrs.append(starts[r])
    lines.append(f'{v} {rep} {A} '+' '.join(f'{a:032x}' for a in addrs))
print('\n'.join(lines))
PY
/usr/bin/time -f 'elapsed %e rss %MKB' timeout 120 tmp/engine_test < /tmp/worst.plan > /tmp/worst.out 2>/tmp/worst.err; echo rc=$?; cat /tmp/worst.err | tail -5; ls -l /tmp/worst.out
